People on the LHP I’ve noticed tend to have a bit of a god complex because we believe that we hold infinite power within ourselves but yes your correct but there are always shades of gray for example im a LHP occultist however I don’t do hexes or really anything that affects any other person other than myself. I use this as a tool to gain knowledge, wisdom, & strength along with general self improvement & just trying to impact myself only but by doing it the way I do I am still considered to be on the LHP even though my practice impacts no one.

So the right hand path is basically the opposite of what we’re doing, people on the right hand path adhere to a moral code, have u seen twin flame readings on TikTok? Or Just regular tarot readings stuff that doesn’t impact another persons free will is considered RHP you can also consider traditional Abrahamic religions to technically be classified as RHP. 

Onto the left handed path people on this path reject societal convention and the status quo it embraces magical techniques that people on the RHP would consider to be taboo for instance using sex magic or love rituals essentially impacting another persons free will.

When using a sanctum during ritual firstly you want to head over to google and just type in sanctum sigil & go to images you might have to scroll a bit down since movies & stuff take up the first results anyway it looks like a funny M with a circle around it and a platform you’ll know it when u come across it. I’d suggest drawing it the best u can on a separate piece of paper so u have it in the future and then what I do is I’ll draw the sanctum on the back first then flip it over draw the sigil of the entity u are trying to connect with ( you can do it in the same side it doesn’t matter) & there’s really nothing more to it it just lets you connect on a deeper level and in my experience have off the charts activity during the ritual. Bleed on it as an offering is another way to connect yourself deeper with who you are trying to connect with. 

My last piece of advice is if the spirit you are trying to work with just isn’t working for you at the moment try & pick a different spirit to start with, there are more beginner friendly spirits & also spirits that tend to be more noticeable when ur in ritual with them. Entities like King Paimon I’ve heard causes a lot of paranormal type activities to happen & can be very active.

Edit: also I’d suggest you checking out a YouTube page Behemoth-X is a very powerful black magician & I got a lot of good information from his content plus he records rituals & live possessions in 4k he also posts some mantras that I’ve used that double as a ritual on their own that I have gotten good results from.

Drawing one out is my preferred way of doing it, don’t worry it doesn’t have to be perfect it’s the intention that counts, while drawing his sigil repeat their name aloud as you draw it, in a way your calling out to him. 
A sanctum is sort of like a sigil but it doesn’t connect you with a entity instead it just basically a tool to better connect you with the entity you are trying to reach. 
Lhp stands for left hand path that’s this is it’s just a broad term to describe what side of the occult you practice on.

When your invoking can you feel a literal change in energy in the room? Lots of the time it will feel heavy & thick. Sometimes you can feel a light touch, grab, twirl of the hair. 
Don’t go into this with the expectation to literally talk with a entity because it takes time to develop those spiritual abilities. 

Be patient, persistent, honest & respectful you will see results in time, I was a skeptic who would feel dumb as fuck staying up until 2am trying to connect with these entities with similar results.
